test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 5: COURSE STRUCTURE MANAGEMENT (DELETION & ORGANIZATION) - Phase 4: Cleanup
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Logout After Course Structure Management
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher is logged into the system and has successfully managed course structure (created file groups, deleted files, deleted sessions) on the 'Course Details Page'. Their session is active.
test_cases.expected_result: Upon successful logout, the teacher's session is terminated, and they are redirected to the 'Landing Page'. All temporary authentication data is cleared, and the system notifies the user of successful logout. The outcome is successful (True).
test_cases.post_condition: The teacher is logged out of the system and is on the 'Landing Page'.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Logout' button in the user menu on the 'Course Details Page'.
The system confirms the logout request.
The system terminates the current user session, clearing any temporary authentication data.
The system redirects the user to the 'Landing Page'.
